zh.name: Gemini Omni Flash 视频编辑
zh.description: 按提示词修改一段视频，可用图片作为人物、场景或风格参考。

prompt.help: 说明要增加、删除或替换的元素。可上传人物、场景或风格参考图。最多 20,000 字符。

video.help: 上传原视频，最长 10 秒、最大 100 MB。也可在高级区填写公开地址。

reference_image_1.help: 上传 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP，每张最多 20 MB。可通过高级区添加来源。

en.name: Gemini Omni Flash Video Editing
en.description: Edit a video with a prompt and use optional image references for characters, scenes, or style.

prompt.help: Describe the elements to add, remove, or replace. Optional images can provide character, scene, or style references. Use up to 20,000 characters.

video.help: Upload a source clip up to 10 seconds and 100 MB, or enter a public URL under Advanced.

reference_image_1.help: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 20 MB. Additional sources can be entered under Advanced.

thinking_level.help: A higher level may improve the result for complex prompts and increase generation time.

seed.help: Enter an integer. Use -1 for a random seed.

reference_image_2.help: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 20 MB. Additional sources can be entered under Advanced.

reference_image_10.help: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 20 MB. Additional sources can be entered under Advanced.

reference_image_sources.help: Enter one public image URL or Base64 data URL per line. These follow uploads, with a total limit of ten images.

video_source.help: Enter one public video URL in place of an upload. The limit is 10 seconds and 100 MB.

ja.name: Gemini Omni Flash 動画編集

ko.name: Gemini Omni Flash 동영상 편집
ko.description: 프롬프트로 동영상을 편집하고 인물, 장면, 스타일에 참조 이미지를 사용할 수 있습니다.

prompt.help: 추가, 제거 또는 교체할 요소를 설명합니다. 인물, 장면 또는 스타일에 참조 이미지를 사용할 수 있습니다. 최대 20,000자입니다.

video.help: 10초 이하, 100 MB 이하의 원본 영상을 업로드하거나 고급 설정에서 공개 URL을 입력합니다.
